## 0.38.0 — 2026-10-16

- Version: `0.38.0` (MINOR: backward-compatible website entry for askills.pro course students).
- Environment: `production`; PR `#32`, exact SHA `094ddd52ff2d3cd814d65576366032e5f981c9a8`, exact-main validation run `38899926111`, approved production run `38900595582`.
- Deployment evidence records `readback: passed` at `2026-10-16T12:32:16.536154+00:00`; this is the deployment-evidence timestamp, not a separately observed atomic-switch time.
- Course URL: `https://vydno.capital/?start=course`. Attribution survives all six landing CTAs and the quiz CTA. New and existing verified identities reuse the standard onboarding/card-link/PWA flow; attribution alone does not activate a bonus.
- The 90-day course bonus is gated by confirmed card-link and checkout consent. The deployed localized popup thanks students of «Фінансова грамотність» on askills.pro. Renewal/price/consent and payment protections remain server-owned.
- Public production browser acceptance: 17 passed checks across `320×740`, `390×844` and `1440×900`; landing/quiz attribution, anonymous profile HTTP 401 and no bonus popup, OIDC start redirect destination, and live root/quiz HTML plus both course JavaScript files byte parity with the CI artifact. These do NOT establish real authentication, payment or installation.
- **ARTIFACT DEPLOYED; DELIVERY INCOMPLETE:** real-owner Telegram login, confirmed card-link and the resulting 90-day bonus/popup, returning-user non-duplication, and actual phone standalone-PWA launch remain unverified. No real payment/card link, financial transaction or provider approval was performed by the agent.
- Tracked evidence and acceptance boundary: `code/docs/releases/0.38.0-course-web-offer.md`. Canonical `code/` has unrelated local work and was not reset or overwritten.

# My Cash Flow Bot — Project Spec Pack

> **ПРАВИЛО №1: ОСНОВНА ВЗАЄМОДІЯ ЛЮДЕЙ ІЗ ПРОДУКТОМ — PWA.**
> Вхід із сайту, оплата, встановлення та робота з іконки PWA — основний користувацький маршрут. Telegram забезпечує ідентифікацію й допоміжні комунікації, а не замінює PWA.

> Current state: this project is DB-first/Postgres. Older Google Sheets-first documents are historical and should not be used as the current source of truth. See `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` and `docs/DEPRECATED_DOCS.md`.

Current state:
This project is DB-first/Postgres. Older Google Sheets-first documentation is historical/deprecated and should not be used as current source of truth. Future Codex tasks should start from `AGENTS.md`, `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`, `docs/CODEX_CONTEXT.md`, and `docs/PROJECT_INDEX.md`.
Current runtime also supports `USDT` in base/account currency presets, accepts custom `3-10` uppercase Latin currency codes for account creation, requires manual FX input for cross-currency internal transfers, and now auto-provisions a fixed 15-item expense category catalog for every user without a category step in onboarding.

## Current Mini App Delivery

Production patch `0.35.12` simplifies PWA installation: Android gets one `Встановити і додати на головний екран` CTA for the real native prompt with honest manual fallback; iPhone Safari immediately gets an animated Share -> Add to Home Screen -> Add -> open Vydno guide; Telegram requests external Safari/Chrome rather than installing inside its WebView. Exact release `75c25f9b553922231fd4cb0e69dfb1162d19f332` is active from production run `38445382510`; production readiness, encrypted off-host backup, public routes, and deployed JS/CSS/inline-source parity passed. Real-phone OS installation and Telegram external-browser opening remain device acceptance checks. The install coach stays dismissible, respects reduced motion, and never treats prompt acceptance or manual acknowledgement as confirmed OS installation. No financial, schema, authentication-backend, or payment behavior changed.
